caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle, facing slightly to the right. The chair features two long, curved rockers at the base, four straight legs, and ornate decorative carvings at the top of the backrest and along a horizontal panel under the seat. The backrest includes vertical spindles and a central decorative slat with a carved leaf or feather design. The armrests are straight and extend forward, supported by turned supports. The seat is upholstered with a patterned blue fabric featuring gold or yellow floral and vine motifs. The overall color of the wood is a warm brown, and the background of the drawing is plain, off-white paper without any additional objects or details.
title: Rocking Armchair
